description: Docker-based sandbox for running agentic coding tools. On Windows a launcher that forwards to the Linux build inside WSL2.
notes: enclave.exe is a launcher, not a native port: it forwards every argument to the Linux enclave binary inside a WSL2 distribution.
Install WSL2 and a Linux distribution (wsl --install), make Docker available inside it, then install the Linux enclave build in that distribution.
Run enclave from a directory inside the distribution, for example \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\you\project.
